title: Typing challenge: reply to Doggo
drDigitalIntro:
You have learned the whole keyboard — now let's put it to work!
• Doggo is hungry and sent you a message in the Messages app.
• Open Messages from the dock, find Doggo in the contacts list, and type a reply.
• You will need letters, numbers, spaces, punctuation, and the Shift key for capitals.
• This is exactly how you send a message on a real computer — the same steps work in any messaging app.

steps.say: Click on Doggo to open the conversation.
Type: Sure Doggo, I will give you 32 pebbles and 6 bones. Is that okay?
steps.value: Sure Doggo, I will give you 32 pebbles and 6 bones. Is that okay?

drDigitalSuccess: Doggo is thrilled — and your typing skills are impressive! You used capitals, numbers, commas, and a question mark all in one go.
drDigitalHint: Click Doggo's name in the list on the left. Then click the text box at the bottom, type the message, and press Enter or click Send.
